note: Reference amounts for adults and children of four years and older, used only to express a nutrient as a share of a daily reference. Nutrition is secondary on this site — it matters for smoothies, shakes, lattes and juices and is close to meaningless for a Martini beyond its energy — so these figures label a figure, they never evaluate a reader against one.

source.title: Daily Value on the Nutrition and Supplement Facts Labels

energyNote: 2,000 kcal is a labelling convention, not a recommendation, and individual needs vary. It is stated so the percentage beside it means something, not as advice.

deliberatelyAbsent.alcohol: There is no daily value for alcohol and eXir does not invent one. The site states how much alcohol a drink contains, in grams and in both standard-drink measures, and holds no view on what anyone's limit should be. Guidance on that comes from health authorities in the reader's own country.
